label: Truth tracks being, and greater truth tracks greater being
paraphrase: As each thing stands in respect of being, so it stands in respect of truth: a thing has truth exactly when it has being, and one thing is more true than another exactly when it is more a being than it (truth said of things).
note: OPEN analyst reconstruction, not a proposition Aristotle literally states. It promotes the contextual 'as ... so' of Metaphysics II.1 to globally quantified presence and pairwise-order biconditionals. Its Lean verum parameter is tagged with thin TRUE_7 and encodes no conformity to intellect. The TRUE_3 link records an intended Thomistic interpretation from ST I q.16 whose application to that parameter is open. The pinned Greek witness bears on this reconstruction through a supports relation; the distinction is substantive, not a new Lean theorem. The verified Aristotle-to-maximal-being argument remains conditional on this exact unreduced premise, with no unadvertised TRUE_7→TRUE_3 transfer. See docs/notes/source-fidelity-1849.md (#1849).
